paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis of FIG. 4
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a haloscope search (UWA, Perth). New measured 95% CL exclusion on axion-photon coupling g_agamma >= 3e-12 GeV^-1 over 63.2-67.1 ueV (15.28-16.23 GHz), excluding ALP cogenesis in this range. The headline limit is quoted as a single value over the mass range in the abstract/text; the actual bin-by-bin limits shown in Fig. 4 vary somewhat and have gaps at mode-mixing regions (15.58-15.61, 15.65-15.69, 15.96-16.15 GHz) not captured here. Assumes axions constitute all local DM with rho = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. Total systematic uncertainty on g_min ~10%.
